QuestInfo.name: Karl's Mistake
QuestInfo.0: Visit #bManager Karl#k in #b#m220020300##k. He needs a reliable problem-solver...
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate #r#k#r#o4230111##k and #r#o4230112##k monsters, since there are too many. 80 of each should do. Wonder why the old man looks so happy?
QuestInfo.2: As #bManager Karl#k requested, you eliminated #r80#k #r#o4230111##k and #r#o4230112##k monsters. And you got paid!

0.0: Ha ha ha... You over there! You want a part-time job? I'll pay you top-Meso.

yes.0: Okay. It's not anything difficult. Oh, I'm #bManager Karl#k, by the way. I'm in charge of the whole factory, which means I'm always giving it my all. Even on that one day, when the stars were falling from the sky...
yes.1:
I was so tired, I fell asleep... That's when it all started. There wouldn't have been any problems if I'd just slept calmly, but my hand just happened to be on the factory emergency power button.  \n
#eClick!#n\n
I flipped the switch in my sleep. Ha ha ha...
yes.2: The Robo production line flipped out and filled the factory with malfunctioning models. That's why I need you to take out #r80#k #rRobos#k and 80 #rMaster Robos#k. I'll pay you handsomely, of course.

no.0: Come on! Lotsa Mesos to be had!

1.0: Oh, things are much better without those tin cans clanking around. Good job.

yes.0: Here... I said I'd pay you handsomely... You like it? 'Course ya do. Thanks again.
